title: Sukkah 4a — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 4 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-004.htm), questions 1–3.

questions.q: If a sukkah is higher than 20 amos and one fills the space with straw he has no use for, is the sukkah kosher?
options: Only if there are no cows around
questions.explain: This is the Rabbi Yosei / Rabbanan machloket over straw left with no plan to remove it — not a clean yes or no.

questions.q: A sukkah is exactly 10 tefachim tall; bits of sechach that let in more sun than shade hang down below 10 tefachim. Kosher?
options: So long as no one is allergic
As long as they are pretty
questions.explain: Abaye wanted to apply the mirror-image of the >20-amos hanging-branches rule; Rava rejected it as a "sagging residence" (dirah serucha). The answer is disputed between them, not a flat yes or no.

questions.q: A sukkah higher than 20 amos becomes kosher via a raised platform slightly bigger than the sukkah minimum. This platform needs __________.
options: to touch 2, be within 4 amos of the third
need to touch none so long as it is within less than 4 amos of all 3 walls
questions.explain: The center-platform case: valid as long as the gap to the wall is under 4 amos in every direction — it doesn't need to physically touch any wall, curved-wall (dofen akuma) covers the gap on all sides.
